Monthly tracking

Monthly totals include snapshots recorded during the selected calendar month. Because each checkpoint is a separate snapshot, views across different windows are not added together unless “All windows” is selected. Use one window at a time for meaningful comparisons.

Copyright & evidence

Evidence checklist

Mark items for each work. This is an organizational checklist, not legal advice or proof of registration.

Copyright reminders

  • Keep dated drafts, project files, final masters, and original camera footage.
  • Save publication URLs and dated screenshots for each platform.
  • In the U.S., copyright generally exists when an original work is fixed in a tangible medium; registration is a separate process and provides important legal benefits.
  • Record whether a work is a composition, a sound recording, or both; they can involve separate rights.

About & version history

1.0.07
Revision release — filming setup tracking
Filming Setup dropdown added

Version format: MAJOR.MINOR.REVISION (X.X.XX). Major releases indicate foundational changes; minor releases add substantial capabilities; revisions contain fixes and small refinements.

Release history

VersionRelease noteScope
1.0.00Initial release under the new numbering scheme, based on Creator Studio's prior v5 feature set.Analytics and insights; content planner; creative library; video, monthly, and cross-platform tracking; copyright evidence; backup and restore.
1.0.03Applied Prairie Preludes logo and coordinated app/PWA icons.Branding refinement; versioned HTML filename; manifest and service-worker updates.
1.0.06Added video length and video filter fields to footage asset records.Fields are saved, editable, and displayed in the footage catalog; older records remain compatible.
1.0.07Added Filming Setup tracking to footage asset records.Fixed dropdown choices: Handheld, Flow 2 Pro Gimbal, Tripod, and Gimbal + Tripod. Saved, editable, and shown in the footage catalog; existing records remain compatible.

Future release convention: 1.0.07 for a small fix, 1.1.00 for a substantial capability release, and 2.0.00 for a major redesign. The revision resets to 00 when the minor version increases.

Local data and backup

Records are stored in this browser on this device. Clearing browser data or uninstalling may remove records. Export backups regularly and keep them somewhere safe. The app does not automatically sync between devices.

Backup status will appear here.

Imports are previewed before you choose to merge or replace. Keep a dated backup outside this browser. The displayed backup date records exports made from this app on this browser only.

Install on Android

  1. Host this app on a secure HTTPS site (or use a compatible local web server).
  2. Open the site in Chrome on Android.
  3. Use Chrome’s menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

The downloaded package includes a manifest and service worker. A service worker and install prompt require an HTTPS origin (localhost is allowed for development); opening the HTML file directly is not enough for full PWA installation.

Privacy

This is a local-first tracker. No analytics or external services are included. Platform metrics must be entered manually; the app does not connect to social media accounts.
